channel.title: Mix That Drink - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Mix That Drink (mixthatdrink.com)

item.title: Fat Charley Drink Recipe
item.description: A tropical cocktail that blends coconut, banana, and fresh orange with a hint of cranberry for a bright, sipping drink.

item.title: 25 Spiked Hot Chocolate Recipes for Grown-Ups
item.description: Warm up with boozy hot chocolate recipes that pair rich cocoa with tequila, bourbon, Kahlua, and festive garnishes for cozy winter nights.

item.title: Heated Cape Cod
item.description: A warmed Cape Cod sounds plain, but hot cranberry juice smooths out and vodka blends in gently for an easy cold weather drink you will want twice.

item.title: Hot Buttered Rum Classic Cocktail
item.description: Have you heard the news? Turns out butter is good for you! And on that note, it's about time for the classic Hot Buttered Rum to make a comeback!

item.title: Boozy S’mores Hot Cocoa
item.description: Boozy S'mores Hot Cocoa is just right to take the chill off a cold winter evening. It blends S'mores flavored vodka with hot chocolate for a toasty chocolate flavor with hints of honey and cinnamon.

item.title: 26 Winter Cocktails to Chase Away the Cold
item.description: Enjoy cozy winter cocktails that blend rich flavors like chocolate, coffee, and spices, featuring classics like Irish Coffee and Hot Toddy for warmth and comfort.

item.title: KGB cocktail
item.description: A layered KGB cocktail shot with coffee liqueur, Galliano, and brandy that looks bold, tastes smooth, and comes together faster than you expect.

item.title: Azteca Cocktail Recipe
item.description: Rich coffee, soft chocolate, and a hint of orange come together with tequila for a balanced after dinner cocktail that feels indulgent but clean.

item.title: Jack Knife cocktail recipe, featuring Jack Daniels and Baileys
item.description: A bold whiskey and Irish cream cocktail with a smooth finish and serious kick. Find out why this pairing keeps showing up in classic drinks.

item.title: Western Sling Drink Recipe
item.description: A fruity gin cocktail with pineapple juice and lemon that stays balanced and easy to drink while quietly packing more punch than it seems.
